messages:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Automated hold placed: canary rollout for `v1.9.12` paused due to incident in eu-west-1. Reason: 503 spike on inference-serving. Holding at step canary 3/10. Details: https://incident.redwood/INC-2026-042

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Pulling logs now — looks like request fanout + kvcache evictions. Reproducing locally.

emily: Thanks. Do not proceed with further canary steps. Can we pin the previous variant (`v1.9.11`) as a safe fallback?

raul: We can pin. Also seeing kernel OOMs during model compile for long sequences (>2048). Suggest short-term: cap `max_seq=1024` for canary and reduce batch size.

ops-lead: No hot rollback yet. Plan: hold + pin + staggered zone requeue. Emily, decide target reschedule window and communications.

emily: I propose reschedule to tomorrow 02:30-04:30 UTC (less traffic). Pin to `v1.9.11` until then. If rollback is needed, we'll follow the rollback playbook and run preflight QA.

carol: I'll start drafting the customer status note and release note update. ETA ~20m. Include that we're investigating a canary-only issue, no data loss. :memo:

emily: To pin now run: `deployctl pin release v1.9.11 --selector canary --until 2026-04-18T04:00Z` 

deploy-bot: Actioned: pinned `v1.9.11` for canary. Rollout paused. Created ticket RLS-7843. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Quick mitigation: enforce `max_sequence_length=1024` on the canary and set `batch.max_tokens=128`. Opening a short-lived feature-flagged change so we can revert after patch.

raul: PR ready: #4024 — changes `max_seq` + batch limit + extra compile-retries. Will coordinate a canary restart at 02:15 UTC. If healthchecks pass for 15m, we can resume staged rollout.

emily: Updated the calendar and release page. Main rollout moved to 02:30-04:30 UTC. I will also add rollback steps in the release notes and link RLS-7843.

ops-lead: TL;DR: hold in place, pinned to 1.9.11, mitigation PR and config change queued, canary restart planned 02:15, main rollout rescheduled 02:30. Anyone object?

carol: No objections. I'll publish customer comms with the expected ETA and note that engineers are actively debugging.

deploy-bot: FYI — created postmortem placeholder INC-2026-042-PREMP; please assign owners when you have bandwidth.

release-manager: Thanks all. After canary restart, please report health metrics to this thread (latency, 5xx, error types). We'll decide rollback vs resume based on those signals. :eyes:
